description: This file is an HTML webpage that serves as a user interface for visualizing and interacting with database data. It contains styles, layout, and client-side JavaScript logic to load database names, tables, and table data via API calls, and to display this data in a dynamic, interactive table format.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar with database items.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets current selections, and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds HTML to display data rows and columns in a table.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates a table cell with appropriate formatting, handling long text and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full or truncated data.
